#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string z;
    cin >> n >> z;
    bool inside = false;
    int count = 0;
    int outsideMax = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        char c = z[i];
        i++;
        if (c == '_') {
            if (!inside) {
                if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            } else {
                if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    if (!inside && count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
    cout << outsideMax << " " << insideWords << endl;
    return 0;
}
